title: Month-preserving circular shift negative control of humidity alignment
model: R08 rich temp/solar/day/season with vs without latent_potential
scope: post-R08 retrospective falsification; months within each city shifted 7+ days; no field data or causal intervention
interpretation: Site-month climatology and unobserved site-level confounders preserved; daily alignment perturbed. Permutation contrasts are diagnostics, not p values, independent prospective validation, or HVAC energy savings.
